criteria.title: Prepare head/tail metadata but publish head OWN before tail OWN
criteria.task: Prepare head/tail metadata but publish head OWN before tail OWN; identify the first unsafe observation.
criteria.purpose: Assess this concrete Ethernet mechanism, misconception and evidence boundary independently.

knowledge: C17 object lifetime, exact integer arithmetic and explicit controller/transceiver distinction
artifacts: PR-T39-07 learner source/analysis and source identities; missing implementations and physical evidence remain required

reasoning: Prepare head/tail metadata but publish head OWN before tail OWN; identify the first unsafe observation.
Derive and bound: DMA can observe an incomplete chain once the head is owned. Tail ownership and all metadata must precede the first ownership publication.
Separate original model policy, ISO C, protocol, vendor register and electrical claims; state ownership, failure publication and costs.
